Drying is now complete and the moisture readings are back to normal. As you know, we confirmed that the damage is covered under your homeowners policy ANT-HO-204585 as a sudden and accidental discharge, and we sent you a $5,000 advance on Sep 28 for emergency drying and immediate needs.

We have now received the mitigation invoice from Lakeshore Restoration and the rebuild estimate from Northshore Renovation. We are reviewing both this week. Once we approve the rebuild estimate, we will let you know the next steps and the payment amounts. Your policy's $2,500 deductible will be applied to the claim.

If you have any questions in the meantime, or if anything new comes up with the basement, the furnace or your belongings, please don't hesitate to contact me.

Kind regards,
Demo User
